about_short_description.short_description: Ghanem is digital real estate platform specializing in fractional ownership solutions.

product.name: Fractional Ownership
product.description: Enables investors to purchase a documented share of income-generating Saudi real estate, receive rental distributions, and potentially benefit from capital appreciation when the property is sold.

product.name: Usufruct Rights (حقوق الانتفاع)
product.description: Provides investors with contractual rights to receive rental income from income-generating properties without owning the underlying real estate, for a defined investment period.

identifier.value: Ghanem Mobile App and Digital Real Estate Investment Platform

product.name: Ghanem Mobile App and Digital Real Estate Investment Platform
product.description: A mobile and web platform for discovering evaluated property opportunities, investing in fractional ownership or usufruct rights, and managing real estate portfolios digitally.

product.name: Property Offering and Evaluation Service
product.description: Allows property owners to submit assets for consideration while Ghanem assesses and selects properties for potential fractional ownership or usufruct investment opportunities.
